description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Bulb Kit that goes in the Instrument Cluster.
If you haven’t been able to read your speedometer at night now is the time to fix it.
There are Two Main Bulbs and Nine Support Bulbs in the Speedometer so this will do all of them.
Easy to Change Out!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Bulbs, Main
Qty 9 – Bulbs, Support
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
